claims.text: A Loring operations report records: 'It is our opinion that the unknown helicopter has demonstrated a clear intent in the weapons storage area, is smart and a most capable aviator.' This is the phrase from which Fawcett and Greenwood took the title of their 1984 book.

claims.sourceText: NICAP, http://www.nicap.org/intsac.htm , and The War Zone, https://www.twz.com/35674/the-bizarre-mystery-of-unexplained-aerial-incursions-over-loring-air-force-base , both opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Several SAC bases in the northern tier were placed on a high priority Security Option 3 alert during the October and November 1975 intrusions over atomic weapons storage areas, and a SAC security police message of October 1975 was captioned 'Defense Against Helicopter Assault'.
